name: escape-from-red-hat
description: Pixel-art office evacuation: five people, each driven by its own LLM tool-calling agent, against a deterministic simulation engine.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @escape/server" "npm run dev -w @escape/web"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vitest run
